title: NIST WebBook: aluminium oxide is Al2O3, molecular weight 101.9613 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists aluminium oxide as Al2O3, molecular weight 101.9613 amu, CAS 1344-28-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for aluminium oxide, CAS Registry Number 1344-28-1, lists molecular formula Al2O3 and molecular weight 101.9613 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 101.94782112 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is not printed in the JSON-LD MolecularEntity. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
